prompt: In this soft watercolor illustration, a young girl in a bright yellow sundress stands on the left, holding a red plastic shovel next to a large sandcastle. Beside her, a golden retriever sits attentively, looking at a blue bucket placed near its paws. In the center foreground, an older man with white hair wears a striped shirt and leans on a wooden walking stick, smiling down at a small crab crawling on the wet sand. To his right, a woman in a flowing teal dress points toward the horizon where three sailboats drift on calm waters. A picnic basket rests on a checkered blanket in the lower right corner, with apples spilling out onto the fabric. A seagull perches on a piece of driftwood behind the dog, while another flies overhead. The background features gentle waves lapping at the shore under a pale sky with wispy clouds. Soft pastel hues blend seamlessly, creating a dreamy atmosphere. The light is diffused and warm, suggesting late afternoon. The style is distinctly a watercolor illustration, emphasizing fluid edges and transparent layers.
